remarks:
This hunting and recreational property consists of 10.5 acres located in Friendship NY, Allegany County.

The land is mostly wooded with a mix of mature trees and younger growth with a few scattered pines throughout.  There are open areas through the timber and several spots with a gentle lay of the land, with areas suitable for potential food plots.  A natural flowing spring is located on the property.

The parcel offers approximately 2,303 feet of road frontage with electric available at the road.  This is a good setup for a cabin, recreation, or hunting.  Annual taxes are $710.67.  All rights convey.

The property is located approximately 4 minutes to downtown Friendship NY, 23 minutes to Wellsville NY, 30 minutes to Olean NY, and 1 hour 30 minutes to Buffalo NY.
